title: A test stand-in for a router's form inside captured rounds, over topk-router
description: The package's topk-router plugin with its device selection run without reading the logits back to the host (topk-router checks them finite on the host first), so it runs inside a captured round. For the round driver's tests of a mixture-of-experts model; topk-router provides its own round form.

inner.description: the package's router plugin this stands in for
